exact_statement: For each integer L>=1 let F_L be the disjoint product of the explicit nine-bit GF4 selector-carrier module f, with its ORIGINAL product of actual spectral marginals as reference (uniform on 2^(9L) atoms), and reveal any adaptively ordered distinct selectors with inherited-reference stops. With alpha=25/32, pi=(1/50,49/50), the global reference probability of a t-step physical history b with k G outcomes is R(b)=(1-alpha^L)2^(-t)+alpha^L pi_G^k pi_H^(t-k). If T_b is the tensor of separately transported local descendants, the actual source-relative terminal correction is d_b=KL(p_b||Q_b)-KL(p_b||T_b)=log2(R(b)/prod r_(b_j)), r=(1/8,7/8). At a fixed depth E d_b=t c-O_(L,t), c=(1/2)log2(16/7)>1/2, 0<=O_(L,t)<=-log2(1-alpha^L); hence E d_b>L/4 at t=L for every L>=4. Already at L2 after one G, KL(Q_b||T_b)=infinity, with Q_b mass343/848 on T_b-zero/actual-source-zero cells. The finite signed actual-source correction remains valid and retains negative paths. Every adaptive selector stopping cut is paid by the SAME initial A_L=5L/2 via E K_terminal+E sum O=A_L, redirecting only unconsumed local outcome capacity; with supplied original S_L=23L/2 and old unrelated omega<=S_L/4 the remaining original bank is at least49S_L/92. Full terminal H stays on both sides. This refutes numerical tensor substitution without an actual reference replacement, not FEI or a policy that really installs T_b.
hypotheses: Explicit module and field representation in PROOF sections2-3; disjoint physical products; finite L.
Fixed ORIGINAL root reference is the actual full product of spectral marginals, not a newly supplied descendant reference.
Global coherent transport uses the actual source kernel with the mandated fair extension on every source-zero row; physical outcomes are fair.
Only distinct selectors are queried; arbitrary adaptive selector order/stops allowed. No ordinary/carrier query, actual reference replacement or second reset is asserted.

Original bank is genuinely unused except old omega and one initial A allocation. Redirected outcome credit is pending/unconsumed, never a refund of a consumed debit. All actual terminal H and KL are retained.
